recurring.name: Name
recurring.hint: Once a month on the charge day an expense is created automatically and you get a notification.
recurring.confirmDelete: Delete payment “{{name}}”? Transactions it created will stay.

costSources.hint: Costs of connected services are updated daily: one transaction per service per month. If the service is already in recurring payments, remove it there to avoid counting twice.

hetzner.title: Hetzner Cloud
hetzner.hint: Monthly cost of current servers (with backups), IPv4 and volumes by Hetzner pricing, VAT included. Token: Hetzner Console → project → Security → API tokens, Read access is enough. Connect each Hetzner project separately.

deepseek.title: DeepSeek
deepseek.hint: DeepSeek has no spending history in the API, so spending is derived from balance decreases between daily checks; top-ups are not counted. Key: platform.deepseek.com → API keys.

costSources.title: Cost import
costSources.inSettings: Cost import from services (Hetzner, DeepSeek…) — in Settings → Integrations

hetzner.1: Open console.hetzner.cloud and choose the project whose costs you want.
hetzner.2: Security → API tokens → Generate API token, permission “Read”.
hetzner.3: Press “Connect a service” here, choose Hetzner Cloud and paste the token.

deepseek.2: API keys → Create new API key; copy it — it is shown once.
deepseek.3: Press “Connect a service” here, choose DeepSeek and paste the key: spending is counted from the changes of the balance.

cashFlow.title: Cash flow
cashFlow.subtitle: Income and expenses over half a year — click a month to open it

upcoming.title: Upcoming payments
upcoming.subtitle: Recurring payments not charged yet this month
upcoming.none: Everything for this month is already charged
upcoming.noPayments: No recurring payments yet — add them in the “Recurring payments” tab

categories.title: Spending by category
categories.subtitle: Click a category to see its transactions

main.label: Main currency: {{currency}}
